meta.name: content-writer
meta.description: Write SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, and content improvements following Google's E-E-A-T and Helpful Content guidelines. Handles new content creation from a keyword or topic, and improving existing pages. Use when asked to "write a blog post", "create a landing page", "improve this page", "write content about X", "content for keyword X", "draft an article", "blog post about", "landing page for", "service page", "product page copy", "rewrite this page", "make this page rank better", "content brief", "how-to guide", "listicle", or any content creation or improvement task for a website.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出符合谷歌SEO标准的高质量网页内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为网站创作或优化能提升搜索排名的内容。
copy.tagline_en: Write high-quality web content that meets Google SEO standards.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or optimize website content for better search rankings.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据关键词或主题，写出符合 Google 搜索质量要求的博客文章、着陆页，或改进现有页面内容。它会先分析搜索意图，再按模板生成带标题、元数据、图片和结构化数据的完整内容。
howto.when: 当你要求“写一篇关于 X 的博客文章”、“创建一个着陆页”、“改进这个页面”或“为关键词 X 写内容”时触发。

say.text: 写一篇关于“如何选择跑步鞋”的博客文章。
say.note: Claude 会先确认意图，然后生成带大纲的完整文章。

say.text: 为我的网站创建一个“SEO 服务”着陆页。
say.note: Claude 会生成页面文案、CTA 和结构化数据。
Claude 会审计现有内容并给出重写版本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, or improve existing content based on a keyword or topic. It analyzes search intent, then generates full content with title, metadata, images, and structured data following Google's guidelines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "write a blog post about X", "create a landing page", "improve this page", "write content for keyword X", or similar content creation or improvement tasks.

say_en.text: Write a blog post about "how to choose running shoes".
say_en.note: Claude will confirm intent and generate a full post with outline.

say_en.text: Create a landing page for my "SEO services".
say_en.note: Claude will generate copy, CTA, and structured data.
Claude will audit and rewrite the content.
